nodes.label: Editorial fact-check workflow: release control implementing the public editorial policy and claims register, not proof a statement is correct merely by appearing in the repo
2026-07-21 high-risk remediation pass: all 76 existing article routes had unsupported prices, guarantees, customer outcomes, rankings, AI-citation promises, and unsourced figures removed or replaced
Per-article ledger: record exact claim, classification, primary source URL, dates, scope, calculation, wording limitations, owner/reviewer/review date, permission record for every material assertion

Review cadence table: prices/incidents/current-news 30 days; competitor/product-capability comparisons and market data/benchmarks 90 days; legal/privacy/security guidance on change and >=90 days; stable technical explanations 12 months

Editorial release gate: 8 checks including claims-register mapping, metadata/copy/FAQ/schema agreement, lab-vs-field distinction, no guaranteed outcomes, single primary intent, working links, reviewer approval with next review date
Ongoing backlog: article-level source ledgers remain incomplete, especially for current-year news, vendor plans/policies, security incidents, laws, market data, and named comparisons
